reason: The cited evidence confirms that DP-GEN active learning was used to train a DNN potential on crystalline and liquid HECN structures, supporting the feasibility of the training workflow. However, the evidence does not provide any quantitative comparison of phase-space overlap, TI path mismatch, or free-energy accuracy between DeepMD and EAM references, leaving the claimed 40–50% reduction and the mechanistic link to improved overlap unsupported.
premises: Active learning (DP-GEN) systematically expands training to underrepresented solid/liquid configurations
DeepMD potential provides a smoother, more continuous representation of the ab initio energy landscape than EAM
Improved configurational diversity in training enhances phase-space overlap between reference and target
Better phase-space overlap reduces discontinuities and mismatch along the thermodynamic integration path
The approach is applicable to refractory high-entropy alloys with 4+ elements at 3000–5000 K
